error_code.description: Snake-cased exception class (gate.py _error_code: strips 'Jev' prefix, CamelCase→snake_case). Was f"error:{code}".

stale_legs.description: Every stale leg named (ADR-014: no silent short-circuit). Was "freshness:" + "|".join(fresh_reasons).

detectors.description: Instruction-firewall detectors that fired. Was verdict.reason() = 'firewall_flagged:<detectors>'.

evidence.description: Optional inline evidence snippets; full evidence rides evidence_refs.

digest.description: true when the step folded into the aggregate digest instead of paging (failopen_step2_digest/step3_digest). OPTIONAL: absent means the step paged (false). Producers MUST NOT fabricate it for error-driven steps — omit it instead.

error_code.description: Present when the step fired because of an error (failopen_stepN_error).

policy_reason.description: Policy-layer reason code, e.g. 'policy_gate_not_configured' (policy_lifecycle.py:535). Open VOCABULARY pending Q3 (canonical PolicyVersion.content) — Type-1, Aditya's item — but closed SHAPE: snake_case only, so 'error:TimeoutError|leg1|leg2' cannot ride one level down in the machine-readable channel.

reason_detail.description: Simple reasons carry no structured fields. If data is needed, the reason belongs in the structured set — propose an amendment, don't stuff reason_detail.

description: The command L4 hands L5: what to DO about an alert, why (machine-checkable), and where the proof lives. Vocabulary pinned pending-R9-ratification (see README §1). Wire serialization is explicit and versioned: every instance carries contract + contract_version; history is never rewritten (event log is the audit trail).

action.description: Closed action vocabulary (models.py:29). 'folded' (D3): storm-continuation absorbed into the aggregate page — intentionally not forwarded, NOT suppression.

contract.description: Self-identifying contract name on the wire.

contract_version.description: Additive-only changes inside a version; a true break takes a new version (C7 compat rule, OPERATING-RULES §1.1). Vocabulary values themselves are pinned pending-R9-ratification — see README §1.

detail.description: Human-readable occurrence text (RFC 9457 'detail': specific to this occurrence, never the same text twice). Consumers MUST NOT parse this for logic — machine logic reads reason_code + reason_detail only. See README 'never-crosses'.

evidence_refs.description: References (content hashes, URIs) to the evidence behind the decision: Jev answers, firewall evidence tuples, freshness reports, policy attestation refs. The disposition carries pointers, never raw vendor payloads.

reason_code.description: Closed reason vocabulary (P2/R-9 target). reason_code NEVER carries interpolated data — no 'error:TimeoutError', no 'freshness:leg1|leg2'. Structured data lives in reason_detail as FIELDS. pattern + enum together reject the old stringly-typed shapes.

reason_detail.description: Structured variant payload for reason_code values that carry data. Selected by reason_code (see allOf). Simple reasons carry NO fields here — maxProperties 0.
